supporting_observations.claim: The failed svc-grades logons recur roughly once per minute from 13:33:34 through 13:48:35 UTC, matching the inventory description of GradeSync running every minute and re-authenticating on each run.

The recorded failures originate from FILE-ORC-01, identify FILE-ORC-01 as the workstation, and show the same lsass.exe process ID and source address (10.56.20.20), consistent with the expected service host rather than logons from varied or remote sources.
The failures report an incorrect-password status; matching domain-controller records show password-validation failures, and the Kerberos pre-authentication failures report status 0x18.

Given the scheduled svc-grades password rotation at 13:30 UTC and the requirement to update GradeSync manually, the steady failures from the expected service host are consistent with the job continuing to use a stale password. The available records do not prove that this was the cause.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-ORC-01 were not collected from 13:20 to 14:00 UTC because of a collection outage. This does not directly explain the authentication failures.
The supplied authentication records end at 13:48:35 UTC, so they do not show activity for the remainder of the requested window through 14:20 UTC.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish when the password rotation actually occurred or when the GradeSync job was updated.
The records do not establish whether svc-grades authenticated successfully later in the requested window.
The records do not establish malicious intent or identify a human actor.
additional_evidence_needed: No additional evidence is required to close this alert as benign based on the available evidence. If operational confirmation is desired, verify the password-rotation record and GradeSync configuration/update time.
